title: Logarithmically renormalized immersed-boundary approximation of steady Stokes flow around finitely many separated slender rigid filaments
author: Richard M. Höfer; Christophe Prange; Franck Sueur
work: Motion of several slender rigid filaments in a Stokes flow
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.184
difficulty_reason: The centerline Stokeslet formula and minimum-dissipation principle do not give uniform errors as filament capacity degenerates. The authors prove the boundary and near-centerline asymptotics, construct divergence-free extensions with constants uniform in filament thickness, and build a capacitary test field for the local Sobolev error. These estimates produce the stated different logarithmic rates rather than a direct formal rescaling of a fixed-domain bound.
